faqs.question: Why take BCR-ABL IS (International Scale) Transcript fusion Quantification bone marrow Test?
faqs.answer: Test helps in the diagnosis of the disease and monitors effect of therapy.

faqs.question: Is this test for you?
faqs.answer: Doctor may suggest the test in certain type of blood cancer mainly Chronic Myelogenous leukemia.

faqs.question: More Info on BCR-ABL IS (International Scale) Transcript fusion Quantification bone marrow Test
faqs.answer: Monitoring response to therapy in patients with chronic myeloid leukemia who are known to have the BCR/ABL1 fusion transcript forms.
